subject: science
title: Grade 4 Science — Set 2
description: States of matter, solar system, food chains, and the body

questions.question: Which state of matter has a definite shape and volume?
questions.explanation: Solids have both a definite shape and a definite volume. Liquids have a definite volume but take the shape of their container.

questions.question: How many planets are in our Solar System?
questions.explanation: There are 8 planets: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune. Pluto is now classified as a dwarf planet.

questions.question: Which gas do we breathe in to stay alive?
questions.explanation: We breathe in oxygen (O₂). Our cells use oxygen to release energy from food.

questions.question: What is the main source of energy for all life on Earth?
questions.explanation: The Sun is the primary source of energy. Plants use sunlight to make food, and animals eat plants.

questions.question: What is the process by which plants make their own food?
questions.explanation: Photosynthesis: plants use sunlight, water, and CO₂ to make glucose and release oxygen.
